description:
SANDBOX ONLY - never reaches a real buyer. Safe send: first checks the buyer VAT in VIES, whether the buyer can be
reached on Peppol, and the buyer name against EU/UN/OFAC/UK sanctions lists, then creates + validates the EN 16931 invoice
(same JSON as create_einvoice), and returns one preflight verdict: ok, warn or block, with a plain-English message per check
and, for each invoice error, what is wrong, which field and how to fix it. A block (invalid VAT, close sanctions match,
invoice errors) stops the send. Otherwise it routes, hands off to the transport and returns an Ed25519-signed evidence
receipt (JWS). preflight_only=true: run only the checks and return the verdict, send nothing (use before every send).
checks: subset of ["vat","peppol","sanctions"] (default all; validation always runs). transport: "mock" (simulated,
default), "recommand" or "e-invoice-be" (the UBL is really submitted to that Peppol access point's sandbox, addressed to
W System's own sandbox company). Use it to build and test an integration; real Peppol sending is the REST API POST /einvoice/send with mode=live, after a Peppol mandate and KYC review.
autofix=true (only with preflight_only=true): run the checks on a copy with the safe fixes applied and return it in
autofix.invoice; review it, then send that corrected invoice. A send never changes the invoice.

autofix.description: Only with preflight_only=true: run the checks on a copy with safe fixes applied and return it in autofix.invoice.
autofix.title: Autofix

checks.description: Optional subset of buyer checks: any of 'vat', 'peppol', 'sanctions' (default all; invoice validation always runs).
checks.title: Checks

invoice.title: Invoice

preflight_only.description: If true, only check the buyer (VAT, Peppol, sanctions) and the invoice; nothing is sent.
preflight_only.title: Preflight Only

transport.description: Sandbox transport: 'mock' (simulated, default), 'recommand' or 'e-invoice-be' (partner sandbox); never reaches a real buyer.
transport.title: Transport
